option_relations.rationale: Right ventricular infarction is a specific type of myocardial infarction, which is a broader category.

This option describes a specific type of acute myocardial infarction (inferior wall and right ventricular) with an anatomical variant (mirror-image dextrocardia) and the cause (proximal right coronary artery occlusion), making it a detailed description of an acute myocardial infarction.
Acute inferior-lateral ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) is a specific type of acute myocardial infarction.
